settings.conflict: The CRM settings changed since you opened the page. Reload, then repeat your change.
settings.saveError: The settings could not be saved
settings.reloadError: The current settings could not be loaded

preset.title: Preset
preset.hint: A starting point that sets several options together. You can change any value afterwards.
preset.generalHint: No automatic follow-up, and manual distribution.
preset.phonePackagesHint: Automatic follow-up after unanswered calls, round-robin distribution and a capped discount.
preset.confirmBody: This replaces the current follow-up, distribution, privacy and discount values. It does not change the terms or the lists.

terms.title: Terms
terms.hint: Name the customer, the opportunity and the plan with the words your company uses. Only the display changes; the data stays the same.
terms.genderHint: Sets the form of adjectives such as «جديد» and «جديدة».

followup.title: Follow-up
followup.hint: What happens after a call that has no final result.
followup.attemptsHint: Calls after the first one. Zero turns automatic follow-up off.
followup.intervalHint: The time from one call to the next.
followup.afterAttemptsHint: What happens to an opportunity whose contact never answers.
followup.recycleHint: A lost opportunity returns to the call list after a while.
followup.recycleCyclesHint: After the last repeat the opportunity stays lost.

distribution.title: Distribution
distribution.hint: How new opportunities are assigned to agents.
distribution.roundRobinHint: Each new opportunity goes to the next agent in turn.
distribution.manualHint: Opportunities stay unassigned until a manager assigns them.
distribution.onImportHint: The person importing picks the assignment for each file.
distribution.membersHint: The CRM agents who receive opportunities.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.hint: Who sees what, and what is logged about viewing.
privacy.ownHint: An agent sees only their own opportunities; managers see all.
privacy.teamHint: An agent sees the opportunities of the sales team they belong to.
privacy.allHint: Every CRM agent sees all opportunities; editing stays with the owner.
privacy.viewLogHint: Every opening of a customer record is logged and managers can read it.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.hint: The discount on a plan price at sale.
pricing.discountAllowedHint: When off, a sale uses the plan price as it is.
pricing.discountMaxHint: Above it, only someone with the discount approval capability can save.

packages.title: Plans
packages.hint: What can be sold. The opportunity's value comes from the chosen plan.

stages.title: Stages
stages.hint: The steps of the opportunity pipeline. Exactly one stage means "sold".

outcomes.title: Call outcomes
outcomes.hint: What a call can end in, and what that does to the opportunity.

lostReasons.title: Lost reasons
lostReasons.hint: The reasons offered when an opportunity is closed as lost.

sources.title: Sources
sources.hint: Where an opportunity came from, used in reports.

list.saveError: The change could not be saved
list.name: Name

list.search: Search by name, phone or email
list.empty: Nothing here yet. Add the first record.

board.capped: Showing the first {count} results. Narrow the search to see the rest.

record.managerBanner: The call attempts are used up and a manager has to decide: assign again or reopen.

call.title: Record a call
call.lostNeedsReason: This outcome closes the record as lost and has no reason. Choose the reason to close it.
call.noOutcomes: There are no call outcomes yet. A manager adds them in this application's settings (Call outcomes).

sale.title: Sell a {term}
sale.discountHint: Worked out from the difference between the price and the final price.

lost.confirmBody: It leaves the follow-up. Someone with the assign capability can reopen it.

form.agentHint: Leave empty to take it yourself. Another agent, or the shared pool, needs the assign capability.

errors.conflict: This record changed or was closed. Reload the page and try again.
errors.duplicatePhone: This phone is already on another record.
errors.invalidPhone: This phone number is not valid.
errors.invalidEmail: This email address is not valid.
errors.discount: The discount is not allowed or does not match the prices.
errors.discountApproval: This discount is above the allowed limit and needs someone who can approve discounts.
errors.forbidden: You cannot do this on this record.
errors.stage: A record is not moved to the sold stage here. Use the sale action.

imports.title: Imports
imports.empty: No file has been imported yet.

upload.hint: A CSV or XLSX file up to 5 MB and 5,000 rows. The first row holds the column headers.

mapping.hint: Pick the column that holds each detail. Name and phone are required.
mapping.saveHint: Reuse it with files that have the same headers.
mapping.agentOptionalHint: Needed only when distribution is on import.
mapping.required: Complete the required fields: name, phone and source.
mapping.agentRequired: Choose the agent for the batch.

reasons.invalid_phone: The phone number is not valid

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to import.
errors.profileExists: A saved mapping with this name already exists.
errors.profileGone: The saved mapping no longer exists.

file.file_bad_csv: The file is not a valid CSV file.
file.file_bad_type: The file must be a CSV or XLSX file.
file.file_bad_xlsx: The file is not a valid XLSX workbook.
file.file_duplicate_header: Two headers in the first row have the same name. Rename one.
file.file_no_rows: The file has no data rows.
file.file_not_utf8: Save the file as UTF-8 and upload it again.
file.file_too_large: The file is larger than 5 MB.
file.file_too_many_columns: The file has more than 50 columns.
file.file_too_many_rows: The file has more than 5,000 rows.
file.file_unpacked_too_large: The workbook is larger than allowed once unpacked.

errors.mapping: One of the chosen columns is not in the file.
errors.agentRequired: Choose the agent for the batch.
errors.agentRefused: This agent cannot take this batch. An agent is chosen at import only when distribution is set to on import, and the agent must be eligible.

manager.title: Team
manager.conversionHint: Records created this month and how many of them were won.
